content.body: Yup, you have admin perms there now
And fine by me to move it to the speced org too

Anyone willing to review multipart/form-data and tests? The one caveat is that parsing of Content-Disposition is not really defined yet as I'd like to make sure that matches what we do for downloads. Tests for that are tentative. https://github.com/whatwg/fetch/pull/1922
